description: Accessible NVDA add-on for the Sarvam AI platform for blind and visually-impaired users: text to speech with document upload and MP3 export, speech to text including large audio, translation, transliteration, language detection, an AI Workforce reasoning layer (Sarvam-105B), and OCR via Sarvam Document Intelligence in 23 languages preserving tables and layout. Save results as TXT, Word or Markdown.
